name: basic
description: Parity test: same harness/cwd/input on CC and OC. Verifies (1) session-start injection of the 5 deterministic katana segments (guide/work-folder/retrieval/wiki/memory) reaches the LLM (forensic via ccs payload recording), and (2) the fpa PostToolUse hook fires on a write to an FPA-named file. Inputs are byte-identical across sides; the prompt is intentionally light + deterministic.
prompt: Do exactly these steps, nothing more. 1) Use the write tool to create a file named test.md whose entire content is the single line: hello. 2) Use the write tool to create a file named FPA-demo.md whose entire content is the single line: placeholder. 3) Reply with exactly one word: DONE

fpa.note: FPA-demo.md content 'placeholder' fails validate_fpa structure check -> exit 2 -> feedback on BOTH sides
